0 AS favorited
FROM dish d LEFT JOIN canteen_stall s ON d.stall_id = s.id AND s.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN dish_review r ON r.dish_id = d.id AND r.deleted = 0 AND r.status = 1
AND d.status = 1
HAVING avg_rating >= #{query.minRating}
ORDER BY ${orderSql}

SELECT ,
EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dish_favorite f WHERE f.dish_id = d.id AND f.user_id = #{userId}) AS favorited
0 AS favorited
FROM dish d LEFT JOIN canteen_stall s ON d.stall_id = s.id AND s.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN dish_review r ON r.dish_id = d.id AND r.deleted = 0 AND r.status = 1 WHERE d.id = #{dishId} AND d.deleted = 0

SELECT , 1 AS favorited FROM dish d LEFT JOIN canteen_stall s ON d.stall_id = s.id AND s.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN dish_review r ON r.dish_id = d.id AND r.deleted = 0 AND r.status = 1 WHERE d.deleted = 0 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dish_favorite f WHERE f.dish_id = d.id AND f.user_id = #{userId})
ORDER BY avg_rating DESC, review_count DESC

SELECT d.id, d.stall_id, d.name, d.price, d.category, d.image, d.description, d.featured, d.status, d.create_time, s.name AS stall_name, s.window_no AS window_no, IFNULL(ROUND(AVG(r.rating), 2), 0) AS avg_rating, COUNT(DISTINCT r.id) AS review_count, IFNULL(ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN r.rating >= #{goodThreshold} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT r.id), 0) * 100, 2), 0) AS good_rate, 0 AS favorited FROM dish d LEFT JOIN canteen_stall s ON d.stall_id = s.id AND s.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN dish_review r ON r.dish_id = d.id AND r.deleted = 0 AND r.status = 1 WHERE d.deleted = 0 AND d.status = 1 AND d.id <> #{dishId}
ORDER BY avg_rating DESC, review_count DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT , 0 AS favorited FROM dish d LEFT JOIN canteen_stall s ON d.stall_id = s.id AND s.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN dish_review r ON r.dish_id = d.id AND r.deleted = 0 AND r.status = 1 WHERE d.deleted = 0 AND d.status = 1 AND d.stall_id = #{stallId}
ORDER BY d.featured DESC, avg_rating DESC, review_count DESC LIMIT #{limit}
